# Rahul Pahuja

> Staff / Principal Mobile Systems Architect: enterprise mobile security, hardware-backed cryptography, multi-million dollar scale. Architect of TeeSDK at Idira by Palo Alto Networks (formerly CyberArk). 11+ years across Palo Alto Networks, Bankwest, Conviva, Chevron and Mahindra First Choice Wheels. Based in Indore, India; open to Staff / Principal roles (Bangalore, Hyderabad or remote).

Rahul Pahuja architects mobile security and high-concurrency client infrastructure. Metrics on this site are as reported by Rahul in his resume and portfolio. The full profile is in [llms-full.txt](https://www.therahulpahuja.com/llms-full.txt).

## Key facts

- Role: Staff / Principal Mobile Systems Architect. Most recent employer: Idira by Palo Alto Networks (formerly CyberArk), Staff Software Engineer - Mobile Architecture, Nov 2024 – Dec 2025.
- Signature work: TeeSDK, a zero-trust encrypted storage foundation on Android Keystore and iOS Secure Enclave, tied to $240M in commercial contract value across 1M+ active enterprise seats.
- Other scale: 12B+ events/min on Conviva Android/iOS sensors; 1M+ daily users on Bankwest (Commonwealth Bank of Australia) digital banking; 2,500 DAU on The A2Z Collection e-commerce architecture.
- Now: Principal Mobile Systems Architect of an Independent Systems Advisory & Engineering Lab (Mobile1x), Dec 2025 – Present.
- Contact: therahulpahuja@gmail.com, +91 88190 91000.

[Privacy policy](https://www.therahulpahuja.com/public/privacy_dedup.html)

[Privacy policy](https://www.therahulpahuja.com/notes-app/privacy-policy.html)
